name: Those Stars Never Sleep
source:
After the crash landing of her spaceship in New York City, an alien works together with a runaway to find the missing parts needed to repair it, with the shared mission to reach the stars.

[From [url=https://cuteshadow.itch.io/those-stars-never-sleep]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
她的宇宙飞船在纽约市迫降后，一名外星人与一名逃亡者一起寻找修复飞船所需的缺失部件，并肩负着前往星星的共同使命。

[来自[url=https://cuteshadow.itch.io/those-stars-never-sleep]itch.io[/url]]
